decision.title: Regular expressions
decision.summary: sxml has its own engine for the XSD and XPath regular expression dialect, designed after Saxon HE's engine, built as a Phase 2 packet on sxml_string alone.

body.p: Own engine for the XSD/XPath regex dialect, designed after Saxon HE's engine (regexml is a Rust port that shows the approach). Check the license of any source before porting code. Confirmed at the Phase 0 gate, unchanged; it is a Phase 2 packet (PLAN.md, risks) and needs no substrate support beyond sxml_string.
